requirements.desc: Preparing selection shall return both `flowState: null` and the loaded `preparingFlowState`; when an explicit non-empty run ID does not exist, selection shall return `flowState: null` plus an isolated empty `preparingFlowState` snapshot and shall not fall through to unrelated active or preparing flow discovery.
requirements.note: R1: exposes known and missing preparing selections without active-flow fallback

requirements.desc: FlowCommand and dispatcher target validation shall evaluate `preparingFlowState ?? flowState` for `--expect-run-id`, `--expect-issue`, and `--expect-spec`, returning `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` before mutation, command module execution, lifecycle hooks, agent calls, runtime target persistence, or worktree creation while preserving existing `requiresFlow` routing semantics.
requirements.note: R2: FlowCommand validates every expectation against the selected preparing state

requirements.desc: `flow set request`, `flow set note`, and `flow set auto` shall use coherent preparing routing with matching guards succeeding, each guard mismatch failing before mutation, a non-null expected spec failing while preparing spec is null, guarded explicit unknown runs returning `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH`, and guard-free documented behavior including unknown-run errors unchanged; registry note routing shall declare `requiresFlow:false` consistently with its command class.
requirements.note: R3: request, note, and auto enforce preparing guards before mutation

requirements.desc: `flow run auto-check` and `flow prepare` shall accept and document the standard run ID, Issue, and spec guard options using registry helper conventions; guarded mismatches and guarded unknown runs shall return `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` before auto-check agent execution or prepare branch/worktree/spec creation, guard-free unknown runs shall retain command-specific failures, and matching guarded prepare shall return the promoted spec.
requirements.note: R4: auto-check and prepare reject guarded mismatches before side effects

requirements.desc: After successful prepare, matching run ID, Issue, and spec guards shall continue to succeed against the active flow, changing any one shall return `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH`, and all existing guard-free public behavior and FlowStore ownership shall remain unchanged.
requirements.note: R5: successful guarded prepare promotes the same target and preserves active guards

requirements.desc: Focused unit, end-to-end, and spec-local tests shall pair every retained behavior with evidence: selection shape; request/note/auto guard-free and guarded routes; all mismatch types; unknown-run no-fallback; auto-check no-agent rejection; prepare no-worktree rejection; successful guarded prepare; post-prepare three-guard behavior; and registry/help parity.
requirements.note: R6: dispatcher rejects every preparing mismatch before command loading and hooks
